response.description:
Foundry Tools (rebranded from Azure AI Services)
provide a unified suite of prebuilt, production-ready AI capabilities for
audio, video, images, documents, and text. Seamlessly integrated into the Microsoft
Foundry platform, these tools empower developers to rapidly build intelligent
agents and applications with plug-and-play functionality, robust governance,
and enterprise-grade security. The rebranding simplifies user experience and
accelerates onboarding for agentic AI development.Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Foundry Tools (rebrand from Azure AI Services)
